content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-16|Tron USDT]], Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-first-principles-5|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-14. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets refers to the process of offering digital products such as templates, fonts, and graphics online. In markets where traditional payment processors are blocked or charge exorbitant fees, creators can leverage crypto payments as a solution. This method not only reduces transaction costs—NOWPayments charges just 0.5% compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%—but also provides creators full ownership and control over their transactions. With the right infrastructure, creators can bypass these barriers and maximize their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling digital products with crypto involves several key components. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate order processing and delivery. Crypto payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which offers instant payment verification. This means that when a customer purchases a product, the transaction is processed on-chain, and the creator can deliver the product immediately without relying on third-party platforms. This seamless flow eliminates delays and ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment systems. It empowers artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela to sell their products effectively. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can focus on producing high-quality content rather than navigating payment hurdles. The architecture not only offers a path to financial independence but also fosters a community of creators who own their commerce infrastructure.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, saving you significant revenue compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign digital commerce stack include a hosting solution, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. Hosting can be achieved through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are cost-effective. The backend logic is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates order management. Payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, allowing for crypto transactions in over 300 currencies. Finally, file delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Together, these components create a cohesive system that simplifies selling digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and ensure your product files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy delivery. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that payments and product deliveries function correctly. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the blueprints and templates needed to build your stack instantly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, enabling you to set up a fully functional online store without reliance on traditional platforms. By automating product delivery with tools like Google Apps Script, your customers receive their purchases instantly.
Automate your order delivery with Cloudflare Workers for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring how to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates. This kit enables you to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack efficiently. For more options, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

By using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate product delivery upon payment confirmation, ensuring your customers receive their purchases immediately.
